risk.rationale: No surviving verified findings remain for case-005. Both suspicious signals were rejected with stated criticism: (1) the OWA inbox forwarding rule points to an internal @aegean.edu archive address, so it is not exfiltration; (2) the 193.140.10.9 activity is consistent with shared egress—187 distinct accounts completed MFA from that IP in 30 days, and failures across 68 accounts are background noise rather than a coordinated password spray followed by takeover. With all signals explained away and no confirmed account-takeover chain, the case is benign.
